minutes.headline: Select Board renewed all annual licenses, approved the Q3 preliminary tax bill insert, and named a liaison to the assessors.
minutes.summary: The board met for its last scheduled session before year-end licensing. It heard the town manager's report, including budget calendar dates and the delayed tax bills, and renewed limousine, auto dealer, common victualler, miscellaneous and alcohol licenses. It also discussed a draft board handbook, community event calendar, volunteer events, environmental policies and a mission statement, with workshops planned for January.

public_comment.topic: Police K9 handler and K9 Cody introduced themselves to the board; the dog finished patrol school and will attend narcotics school in April.
Resident at 91 Main Street supported rules on camera use at remote meetings and suggested citizens be able to request in-person meetings for groups that meet only remotely.

votes.motion: Ratify the town manager's appointment of Sandy Richi as assistant meal site manager.
Appoint Tom Alonzo as board liaison to the board of assessors.
Approve the third quarter preliminary tax bill insert, with correction that it go on town letterhead.
Issue limousine licenses for 2024 to First Choice Limousine and Lloyd's Limousine Service.
Approve 2024 auto dealer licenses class one, two and three as read.
Approve 2024 common victualler licenses as presented.
Approve 2024 miscellaneous licenses (jukebox, entertainment, amusement devices) as presented.
Approve 2024 alcohol licenses as presented with two exceptions (Elena's Gourmet Grocery and one other held for compliance).

budget_items.what_was_said: The town received the community compact award as a direct deposit for an inventory and asset management plan for bridges and culverts; DPW is soliciting cost proposals.
The final Unitil incentive was approved higher than first expected; grant covered up to a stated amount and spending so far was reported.

budget_items.topic: FY22 Green Communities competitive grant other uses
budget_items.what_was_said: Grant also covered part of a hybrid cruiser and admin support for reporting.
Bid awarded to the low bidder from four bids, funded in the FY23 capital plan; carport project bids due Dec 20.
A member said typical annual increases average about a couple hundred dollars per household, and that the median matters more than the average.
The fee for a new package store all-alcohol license apparently had not been paid; staff to confirm.
The chair noted an accounts payable warrant amount.
A member reported the school committee faces FY25 budget challenges from loss of ESSER and expected health insurance increases.

decisions.decision: Board will workshop the draft board, committee and commission handbook in the first two meetings of January.
Draft environmental policies to be workshopped in January.
Chair to seek volunteers from schools or the cultural council to compile a community events calendar, with an events email address suggested.
Elena's Gourmet Grocery license and a second license held to next week pending fee confirmation and compliance.
Next meeting December 19; following meeting January 9.

what_happened.line: The Select Board renewed 2024 licenses by vote: limousine, auto dealer, common victualler, miscellaneous and alcohol, with two alcohol licenses held back.
The board approved the third quarter preliminary tax bill insert unanimously, with a correction that it go on town letterhead.
The board appointed Tom Alonzo as its liaison to the board of assessors, with one abstention.
The Elena's Gourmet Grocery license and one other were held to the next week pending fee confirmation and compliance.
The board will workshop the draft board, committee and commission handbook and the draft environmental policies in January.

why_it_matters: The tax bill insert and the new assessors liaison bear on how and when residents are told about their bills, and the town manager reported the tax bills as delayed.
Licenses for local businesses carry through 2024, and the held alcohol licenses show the board checking fees and compliance before approving them.
A member noted that school FY25 budget pressures (lost federal ESSER funds, rising health insurance) are coming, which residents may be asked to vote on in the budget cycle.
watch_next: Next meeting December 19, when the held Elena's Gourmet Grocery license and the second held license return.
January 9 meeting and the January workshops on the board handbook and environmental policies.
